salt-grain.name: kcq
salt-grain.title: Circuit Quantum Electro Dynamics for KLayout
salt-grain.doc: A KLayout Salt package for circuit quantum electrodynamics (cQED) design. Provides technology-driven CPW routing (Manhattan and octilinear, Euler bends, adiabatic S-bends), a default PDK (kcq) with transmon, resonator and Purcell filter PCells, LVS-style netlist extraction, fabrication/DFT verification, and a pipe to Elmer FEM for Energy Participation Ratio (EPR) based Hamiltonian parameter extraction.
salt-grain.author: Technology Innovation Institute
